item.title: English Bikers Turned Japan's Finest Nylon Bags Into Leather Jackets
item.description: Lewis Leathers, the UK's oldest motorcycle apparel label, has transformed PORTER’s luxurious nylon bags into leather bags.

item.title: ASICS Neotide™ Is The Natural Next Step
item.description: ASICS and HAGEL have always been a winning combo, and with the NEOTIDE™, they’ve raised the bar again.

item.title: Tommy Jeans Reworks ’90s Denim Codes for Spring 2026
item.description: For Spring 2026, Tommy Jeans heads to London—a trip that feels less like a departure and more like a natural evolution. See the collection here.

item.title: This Nike Jordan Is the Only Real "Heir" to the Basketball Kingdom's Footwear Throne
item.description: Designed with WNBA stars like Napheesa Collier, the Jordan Heir Series 2 is dedicated to maximizing performance in women's basketball.

item.title: When Louis Met… The Nike Air Max 95 OG Neon
item.description: For the release of the Nike Air Max 95 'OG Neon', and two accompanying JD Sports exclusive tracksuits, JD has surprised everyone by pulling in none other than Louis Theroux to star in their new campaign. A left-field choice that makes immediate sense. His cross-generational relevance mirrors the staying power of the Air Max 95 itself.

item.title: Want to Know What’s Up With Gucci? Look Down at the Loafers
item.description: Gucci's loafers are the one item that most clearly symbolizes the luxury house's current creative direction. So, what do Demna's loafers say about his Gucci?

item.title: Avavav Spills On Oatly
item.description: At Avavav’s Fall/Winter 2026 show in Milan, guests became the spectacle as Oatly amplified the power-shifting performance with oat-based drinks.

item.title: What Other Vegan Caribbean Restaurant Has Its Own adidas Sneaker?
item.description: Most restaurants, nice as they are, don’t have adidas knocking on their door for limited-edition sneakers. But JAH JAH isn’t most restaurants.

item.title: LOEWE Has a New Logo. Did You Notice?
item.description: Subtle as it may be, the new LOEWE logo is also inescapable in Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez's first LOEWE collection.

item.title: COMME des GARÇONS Made a Shirt So Normal Your Dad Would Wear It
item.description: COMME des GARÇONS releasing a trio of luxurious white dress shirts may seem very un-COMME des GARÇONS. It's actually very much the opposite.
